title: Bound tiny-note retrieval and avoid quadratic full-note receipt fitting
outcome: Bound tiny-note retrieval and avoid quadratic full-note receipt fitting
acceptance: A backlog of thousands of tiny notes yields a bounded candidate decode count and logarithmic fitting probes while preserving whole oldest-first prefixes, exact notes_omitted, and both 12 KiB receipt bounds.

completion.summary: Bounded candidate envelopes and logarithmic full-note prefix fitting pass the 1024 tiny-note decode/probe regression and scale gate.
